findings.source: Это вообще мой любимый гриб. От него я чувствую себя хорошо, лучше работает память. Напоминает о хороших временах.
findings.currentTarget: Kwa kweli huu ndio uyoga ninaoupenda zaidi. Huninifanya nijisikie vizuri na kuboresha kumbukumbu yangu. Hunikumbusha nyakati nzuri.
findings.proposedFullTarget: Kwa kweli huu ndio uyoga ninaoupenda zaidi. Hunifanya nijisikie vizuri na huboresha kumbukumbu yangu. Hunikumbusha nyakati nzuri.
findings.objectiveReason: Huninifanya is not the intended Swahili causative verb form; the extra ni makes the sentence malformed. The coordinated memory clause also needs the same mushroom subject.

findings.source: Widow: ВЫ ХОТИТЕ ЗАПЕЧАТЛЕТЬ ЕГО СМЕРТЬ?
findings.currentTarget: Widow: MNATAKA KUNASA KIFO CHAKE KWENYE PICHA?
findings.proposedFullTarget: Widow: UNATAKA KUNASA KIFO CHAKE KWENYE PICHA?
findings.objectiveReason: The speaker addresses the single player: the actual node begins with Тебе and continues with Делай/не трогай/уйди. Russian ВЫ is formal singular here. MNATAKA switches grammatical address to plural inside this single-addressee exchange.

findings.objectiveReason: Exact repetition of the Widow single-player photograph accusation; preserve the same single-addressee correction. This supplemental row has no node metadata and must retain its separate binding/reachability status.

findings.currentTarget: Couple: Amenikera vibaya mno, shenzi huyo, mnaelewa?
findings.proposedFullTarget: Couple: Amenikera vibaya mno, shenzi huyo, unaelewa?
findings.objectiveReason: The husband discusses his wife in the third person with the single player; he separately turns to the wife using Слышишь/Собирай. mnaelewa is plural player address. Use ordinary singular Swahili agreement while preserving the full abusive statement.

addressCaveat: Respectful plural usage exists in some settings; the current approved layer does not define it as the selected single-person strategy. Adjudicate these proposals against the bound scene and locale policy; do not apply as a blind global replacement.
